Munich School of Politics and Public Policy

The Munich School of Politics and Public Policy (HfP) combines excellence in political science with a commitment to dialogue between politics, society, business, and technology. As an institution affiliated with and supported by the Technical University of Munich (TUM), we address pressing political issues and explore the societal opportunities and challenges presented by emerging technologies.

The Professorship of Global Security and Technology focuses on contentious politics, political mobilization, and political violence, with a particular emphasis on the role of information and communication technologies. Key areas of research include the spatial and temporal diffusion of protest, the impact of censorship on political attitudes, public perceptions of human rights and security, and the strategic use of violence during election.

To support these teaching and research activities, the Professorship of Global Security and Technology is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/x). The position is initially for two years, with the possibility of a one-year extension, and is planned to start in November 2026. Remuneration is based on TV-L E13 (100%).

Your responsibilities:

- Collaborating in research and teaching at the Professorship of Global Security and Technology, with a specific focus on quantitative methods and political conflict (broadly defined to include contentious politics, political violence, and digital repression)
- Teaching courses in quantitative methods and political conflict at both Bachelor’s and Master’s levels
- Supervising Bachelor’s and Master’s theses
- Conducting quantitative analyses using primary and secondary data
- Preparing and co-authoring scientific publications as well as grant proposals
- Contributing to the administrative tasks of the professorship

Your qualifications:

- Ph.D. (or close to completion) in political science, economics, sociology, or a related social science discipline
- Excellent knowledge of quantitative research methods and statistics
- Excellent programming skills in R (or a comparable language)
- Aptitude for teaching, ideally demonstrated through prior experience in teaching, tutorials, workshops, or supervision (experience in quantitative methods is particularly desirable)
- Ability to teach in both German and English
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
- Fluency in scientific English (at least level B2 or comparable)
- Research interests in political violence, political mobilization, (digital) repression, public opinion, autocratization, or autocratic politics are desirable

Our offer:

- A full-time position (100%, 40.10 hours per week), suitable for postdoctoral researchers or doctoral candidates nearing the completion of their dissertation.
- The position is scheduled to begin in November 2026 and is limited to two years, with the possibility of an extension for up to one additional year.
- Remuneration is based on the Collective Agreement for the Civil Service of the Länder (TV-L E13).
- The role includes a teaching load of 5 semester hours per semester (typically consisting of two courses and thesis supervision).
- A centrally located workplace in Munich.
- Flexible working arrangements combining on-site and remote work (please note that full-time remote work is not possible).

The Munich School of Politics and Public Policy at the Technical University of Munich strives to increase the proportion of women in its workforce and explicitly encourages applications from qualified female candidates. This position is also suitable for individuals with disabilities. In cases of equivalent suitability, aptitude, and professional performance, preference will be given to disabled applicants.

jobs.occupation: Head of PS Division Incident Management (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
At TÜV SÜD Group, we are passionate about technology. Innovations shape our lives in many different ways, and at TÜV SÜD Group, we are highly committed to playing an active role in this progress. We test, we certify, we inspect, and we advise. We challenge ourselves every day to help ensure the safety of people and society. We live technology. We strive for professional excellence. We make an impact. We take the future into our own hands. We are TÜV SÜD Group.

The PS Division Incident Management Department plays a critical role in our business by ensuring that operational disruptions are identified,  managed, and resolved swiftly and effectively, safeguarding service continuity in a highly regulated environment. It is a key differentiator,
demonstrating our ability to meet stringent compliance requirements while maintaining trust with clients and regulators. Beyond reactive response, it enables proactive issue identification and mitigation, strengthening our “license to operate” by reducing risk exposure and
ensuring accountability. Furthermore, robust incident management minimizes the likelihood and impact of service failures, helping protect the organization from financial losses, reputational damage, and potential damage claims.

Leadership Tasks:

- Work with the current Head of PS Incident Management to lead &
develop of a central team to:
o manage serious incidents/ complaints/ claims in regard to PS
business globally
o to protect the TÜV SÜD brand in regard to the use of
certification marks under PS division
o coordinate global quality assurance activities such as
comparison tests for high-risk products as preventive action
to avoid future incidents
- To take over the position of Head of PS Division Incident
Management by Mid-2027 and ensure a proper handover of
leadership

Tasks of the PS Incident Management in relation to risk
management and damage claims:

- Develop and coordinate strategies to defend PS Division against
unjustified damage claims and reduce legitimate claims to the
extent of the fault
- Coordination of the investigation of serious incidents/ complaints/
deviations or claims (processes and technical issues) with
complaint managers located in the operations worldwide according
to the global PS Division Incident Management Procedure
- Risk assessment and risk reporting to the management
- Manage activities and coordination with external legal counsel as
corporate legal department at TÜV SÜD
- Support PS certification bodies and coordination of communication
with accreditation bodies and supervisory authorities (e.g. in case
of hearing letters and withdrawal of licenses proceedings)
- Coordinate with PS Quality Management to provide input on
improvements based on analysis of incidents/ complaints/
deviations or claims
- Support of operational departments in high-risk projects

Tasks of PS Incident Management in relation to risk management
and damage claims:

- Implementation and maintenance of EU border seizure procedures
according to EU Regulation 608/2013 für TÜV SÜD Product
Service trademarks
- Trade fair inspections in cooperation with customs/criminal
investigators and TÜV Markenverbund e.V.
- Provide anti-counterfeiting training in relation to TÜV SÜD and TÜV
SÜD Product Service marks
- Prosecution of trademark infringements and forgery of certificates,
test reports or licenses in cooperation with certification bodies
- Manage cease-and-desist letters to enforce claims regarding
misuse of TÜV SÜD brand/ marks in relation to Product Service
issues

Tasks of the PS Incident Management in relation to Quality
Assurance:

- Identify high risk products within the testing and certification scope
in the field of Product Service which could cause future incidents/
complaints/ deviations or claims
- Coordinate global quality assurance activities such as elected
comparison tests for high-risk products detected by the risk radar
system
- Analyse the results in close cooperation with technical experts and
Quality Management to determine preventive actions.

Qualification:

- Technical or legal degree
- Strong comprehension skills – especially in technical matters
- Solid legal knowledge - especially in contract law, trademark law,
procedural law, and the German Product Safety Act (ProdSG) and
Medical Devices Regulation (MDR)
- Expert-level knowledge in the areas of accreditation and
certification of consumer, commercial and medical devices
- Resilience, perseverance, assertiveness, and a hands-on
approach
- Flexibility and the ability to quickly grasp complex issues
- Risk Awareness
- Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and
German due to communication with accreditors and market
surveillance authorities as well as law enforcement authorities.
Aditional language skills are welcome

At TÜV SÜD Group, people from more than 100 nations work together – people with different backgrounds, skills and goals. Our strength lies in these many diverse perspectives.

We are committed to being an inclusive and diverse employer by welcoming everyone. Diversity and inclusion are the foundation of our company, and we foster an environment in which all our employees can trust that they will be treated with respect – regardless of age, nationality, ethnic background, disability, gender and gender identity, sexual orientation, religion or belief.

jobs.occupation: Big Data Scientist for the Services Analytics Plateau (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

The Services Analytics Plateau (working mode: Agile Scrum) is searching for an experienced

Big-Data-Scientist (d/f/m)

The project you will be working on represents Airbus Defence and Space's analytics capabilities for our largest customers and all our large aircraft. It delivers improved performance and customer experience and enables a rapid understanding of the potential of digitalization for our customers.

You will be at the forefront of further developing our Data Analytics solutions. The main task will be to find new ways to address challenges with data and digital technologies and support the creation of new services.

We have well over 100 data products and operate more than 50 use cases in production. In addition, we already have a data pool of several terabytes.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Ask the right questions to support the discovery process
- Identify the data-analytics problems that offer the greatest opportunities to the organization
- Perform exploratory data analysis using visualization and sense
- You are or will be familiar with our business and actively follow market trends
- You present your findings to stakeholders using visualization and other means
- Collating data and "data wrangling", i.e. transforming, cleansing and linking it with other data.
- Providing data sets for machine data models; determining relationships between data source attributes
- Apply data mining techniques to carry out statistical analysis.
- Create and validate models, also but not only using ML
- Exploratory analyses of data, extraction of specific content, patching, and statistical analysis
- Develop and implement programm prototypes and production code, mainly in Python
- Supporting the execution of proof-of-concept and ad-hoc requests within the community
- Development and handling of MCMC simulations, as well as output analysis.
- Driving new working methods and new data governance models.
- Presenting results to diverse audiences; from engineers to managers
- Sharing and exchanging knowledge with other teams and working closely with the different support teams, the design office et al.

Desired skills and qualifications

- M.Sc. (ideally Ph.D.) in statistics, mathematics, computer science, physics, aerospace engineering or a related field
- Several years of relevant professional experience working in data-driven projects, preferably within an Agile environment
- Demonstrated expertise in processing and analyzing of: Aircraft sensor and maintenance data, or Aircraft or fleet data, including ILS (Integrated Logistics Support) or in-service data
- Hands-on experience in the development and implementation of health monitoring, predictive maintenance, or Integrated Logistic Support (ILS) models for the aerospace sector
- Deep knowledge and expertise in data analysis and statistical interpretations of data (e.g. probability distributions, statistical tests, anomaly detection, Bayesian inference)
- Experience working in Big Data Projects using Spark and Spark-Submit Jobs for building ELT pipelines and creating data products
- Working knowledge of Unix systems, including command-line operations and scripting (e.g., Bash)
- Expertise in DevOps and Python coding in a production environment, as well as excellent knowledge of SQL technologies and databases
- Experience in the development of visualization tools (e.g. Spotfire) and front-end applications (Streamlit, Django)
- Fluent in English and ideally also in German

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Engineering Change Manager (d//f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Donauwörth
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 24 months

Join us as a working student (d/f/m) in Engineering to actively support our transformation and change towards the Engineering of tomorrow. This role offers an exciting opportunity to support the top management and prepare our engineering for the future by implementing the latest design tools (incl. AI) in an international environment, contributing to the continuous improvement and evolution of our exciting products. In your job you will be able to bring in your creative solutions. You will be coached by experienced experts and top management of our company.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation.
- Partial mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Europe (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Assist in Transformation and Change projects for an international engineering function.
- Assist in the creation, preparation, documentation of workshops, events and roadshows for the leadership team and the engineering teams.
- Support the communication to the teams with creative formats (e.g. podcasts,...).
- Contribute to analyzing the effectiveness of the transformation initatives and identify gaps.
- Support the creation of inspiring presentations.
- Support in operative and administrative tasks.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering and Management, Work & Organizational Psychology, Human Resource, or a comparable degree program.
- Knowledge of—and ideally experience with—G Suite applications and Artificial Intelligence.
- Ideally, knowledge of and experience with Change Management.
- Strong interest in digital technologies and their application.
- Ability to work independently.
- Language skills: Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a strong advantage.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

You work closely with engineering, suppliers, customers, and cross-functional project teams to deliver gas turbine auxiliary systems. Your day includes creating and updating engineering documentation, supporting project execution activities, and coordinating technical interfaces with internal and external stakeholders. You also contribute to the digitalization of engineering processes, support colleagues using SAP S/4HANA engineering-related modules, and ensure project requirements, quality standards, and supplier deliverables are met throughout the project lifecycle.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for customer order engineering activities for gas turbine auxiliary systems
* Creation and maintenance of piping and instrumentation diagrams as well as preparation of engineering documentation, specifications, drawings, data sheets, and parts lists
* Support of data-driven project execution methods and implementation of digitalized engineering processes across multiple teams
* Provision of user support for engineering-related SAP S/4HANA applications and continuous process improvement initiatives
* Coordination of suppliers for engineering and manufacturing activities, including progress monitoring, quality assurance, documentation review, and acceptance inspections
* Clarification and coordination of technical interfaces with customers, suppliers, site personnel, engineering partners, and internal stakeholders

What You Bring

* Degree in process engineering, mechanical engineering, plant engineering, or a comparable engineering discipline, combined with professional experience in project execution
* Experience in at least one relevant engineering field and a strong understanding of engineering project environments
* More than 2 years of experience with SAP S/4HANA, including basic knowledge of Materials Management (MM) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
* Passion for process simplification, automation, digitalization, and openness to new technologies and modern ways of working
* Analytical mindset, structured working approach, and ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, very good English language proficiency, and willingness to develop innovative solutions in interdisciplinary teams 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defense and Space is looking for a

Full Stack Developer - Electronic Warfare Ground Support Systems (d/m/f)

We are seeking a highly motivated engineer to join our interdisciplinary field of Ground Support Systems.
The job holder will become part of an agile team developing state-of-the-art Electronic Warfare ground support systems for the A400M, Eurofighter and Tornado platforms for international clients. Our products enable preparation, test and evaluation of mission data libraries before being uploaded to the aircraft, especially in the context of electronic warfare, defensive aids and electronic combat.

Your location:

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You:

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

Software Engineering Tasks:

- Develop and maintain front-end and server-side logic, databases, and APIs to ensure seamless data and test software throughout the development lifecycle based on customer requirements
- Design Responsibility: Ensure feasibility, reusability, maintainability in software and interface design. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established coding standards and best practices. Perform code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to continuous improvement of the development process.
- Troubleshoot and debug software issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
- Contribute to the selection and evaluation of new technologies and tools to enhance development efficiency and system capabilities. Collaborate with systems engineers, domain experts, and other developers to understand requirements, define technical specifications, and translate them into robust software solution.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Proven professional experience as a Full Stack Developer, with a strong understanding of both front-end and back-end development.
- Proficiency in modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, along with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Strong experience with back-end programming languages such as Python, Java, and associated frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot).
- Solid understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch).
- Experience with RESTful API design and development.
- Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
- Knowledge of software testing methodologies and experience with unit and integration testing.
- Understanding of agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
- Experience with cloud and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
- Prior experience in the defense, aerospace, or electronic warfare domain is highly desirable.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multinational environment.
- Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; German language skills are a plus.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

The Mission: Shaping the Future of Autonomous Flight

As part of the Eurodrone program, you will be building the "brain" of one of Europe's most advanced unmanned aerial systems. You will play a pivotal role in developing the Flight Control System (FCS) and Flight Management System (FMS) that will define the next generation of autonomous flight. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge software engineering and high-stakes aerospace innovation.

Your mission includes:

- Focus: Safety-Critical Software Development for Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS)
- What You Will Achieve: In this role, your work directly impacts the safety and autonomy of the Eurodrone.
- Embedded Implementation: Developing and optimizing high-integrity, safety-critical code that powers flight-critical functions.
- Model-Based Development: Utilizing MBD workflows to design, simulate, and implement complex control laws and system behaviors.
- Lifecycle Ownership: Participating in the full development cycle—from architectural design and modeling to rigorous testing and verification under DO-178C standards.
- Collaborative Innovation: Working alongside multidisciplinary teams of aerospace and software experts to solve the unique challenges of unmanned flight.

Who You Are

We are looking for engineers who are passionate about high-integrity systems.

- The Foundation: Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
- At least 3 years of professional experience in Computer Science or in a related field.
- Embedded Expertise: Proven experience in embedded software development (ideally C) and a deep understanding of real-time constraints.
- Model-Based Mindset: Experience or strong interest in Model-Based Development (MBD) workflows (e.g., ANSYS Scade or MATLAB/Simulink) to drive system design.
- Safety-Critical Awareness: An understanding of the rigor required for high-integrity environments (e.g., DO-178C or similar safety standards).
- The Driver: A proactive approach to solving complex, "unsolved" problems in the field of autonomy and flight control.
- Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal). German language skills are a plus.

Why Join This Team?

- Strategic Impact: Work on a high-visibility, cornerstone European project (Eurodrone).
- Technical Challenge: Tackle some of the most sophisticated software engineering problems in the aerospace industry.
- Growth Culture: We don't just hire for what you know today; we invest in your ability to master the technologies of tomorrow.
- Innovation at Scale: Join a team where your code directly enables the future of autonomous flight.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.
But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Risk Analyst - Client Underwriting (m/f/d) (limited contract)

Join our team at our location in Verl or Berlin – flexible working conditions are available

What will be your challenge:

- Customer credit risk management for our products in the Buy Now Pay Later area across Europe
- Analysis and risk assessment of our consumer portfolios and their ongoing optimization via customization of business rules on merchant and overall portfolio level
- Continuous improvement of underlying data analysis and existing business processes to support our product expansion in new areas
- Collaboration in cross-functional teams working on giant-leap changes in models
- Consulting Key Account Management regarding risk steering measures to maximize customer value
- Supporting the development of our risk steering platforms and the data provider management
- Furthermore, you interact with the BI experts to improve overall monitoring/reporting and the application of advanced analytics

Qualifications

What will help you to succeed in the role:

- Academic educational skills - Degree in mathematics, statistics, or business/economics, preferably with a quantitative focus
- Eager to collect distinct practical knowledge in the application of methods for credit risk steering of consumer portfolios (scoring, decision engines, machine learning) in an international context
- Profound analytical/technical understanding and experience in creating individual data analysis (SQL skills required)
- Professional experience in the finance industry
- You are a team player, flexible and resilient
- You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and German would be a huge benefit

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here (https://bertelsmann-hr.de/docs/Overview_of_Data_Retention_Periods_EN.pdf) .

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here (https://jobsearch.createyourowncareer.com/content/Privacy-Policy/?locale=en_US) .

part of the global Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve
their goals by providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the

executive management, we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to

monitor Cybersecurity risks by performing hands-on risk assessments of

causes.
- As a valuable member of the assurance
team, you prepare, execute and lead Cybersecurity audits on Siemens IT
systems, products, services, factories, and software development centers.
During this process you highlight important observations, translate technical

- In your new role you drive Cybersecurity
in Siemens’ most innovative products. From the product security features,

governance of Siemens, including policies and processes such as incident

etc.
- You work closely with Cybersecurity
experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling
the root cause of the issues and finding innovative solutions to modern
challenges.
- Furthermore, you will drive the continuous
improvement of our internal audit processes, tools as well as
documentation and coach junior team members.

What you need to make real what matters.

- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree)
in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as
CISSP, CISA, CISM are a plus.
- 7+ years working experience in the field
of Cybersecurity within Siemens or a related industry, or a ‘Big 4’
accounting firm or a consultancy in the fields of IT / Cybersecurity and
audit.
- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the
latest trends in Cybersecurity and keeping up to date in a continuously
challenging environment.
- Strong communication, presentation and
project management skills and the drive to find innovative solutions to
establish them in the audit environment.
- You are a subject matter expert in some of
the following domains: user & access management, application security,
cloud environments, network security, vulnerability management &
incident handling, system hardening, asset management, industrial security
controls, secure software development.
- Experience with
leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an
advantage.

languages are a plus.

an international mindset and are open to international travel and working

jobs.occupation: Unix System Administrator – High-Security IT Operations (m/f/d) (Anwendungssystemadministrator/in)
jobs.description:
Help operate IT systems where reliability and security truly matter.

At Data-Warehouse GmbH, you will work in high-security, mission-critical IT environments where stable systems, precise operations, and a strong security mindset are essential.

We are looking for a Unix System Administrator (m/f/d) with a strong hands-on mentality, solid troubleshooting skills, and the motivation to keep complex IT environments secure, reliable, and well-documented.

You will join an experienced international team and contribute to systems that support demanding stakeholders and security-sensitive projects.

At a glance

- Permanent full-time position
- Immediate start
- Location: Munich north, Germany
- On-site role due to security requirements
- Focus: Unix/Linux, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, secure IT operations
- Security clearance required or willingness to go through the process

Your role

In this position, you will support the operation, administration, and continuous improvement of Unix/Linux-based systems, primarily in Red Hat environments.

Your responsibilities include:

- Administer Unix/Linux-based operating systems, including troubleshooting, installation and setup.
- Maintain compliance with security policies, including patch management and vulnerability remediation.
- Perform backups and recovery using tools such as Netbackup.
- Basic hardware management including racking, card/disk replacements, attaching to network(s), etc.
- Installing third party software following provided instructions.
- Document architecture, procedures, and operational guidelines for system administration.
- Willingness to learn and acquire new skills (including acquiring relevant certifications).
- Willingness to work in a rotation system (to cover the service hours) and to work outside working hours (usually one Saturday per month).

Your profile

- Strong expertise in Unix/Linux system administration (RHEL8, RHEL9, or similar).
- Strong troubleshooting skills for Unix/Linux systems.
- Working with ticket system for incidents, problems, change management and configuration management.
- Certifications such as RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer), or similar is an advantage.
- Good knowledge of English—spoken and written.

Nice to have

- IT related Bachelor or Master degree
- Knowledge of ITIL
- Ability to Shell Script
- Knowledge of Container Technolog, especially Rancher
- VMWare/KVM knowledge
- Windows Server knowledge

What makes this role special

This is not just another system administration role.

You will work in an environment where your contribution has real impact: systems need to be secure, available, well-maintained, and compliant. Your work helps ensure that critical IT infrastructures remain stable and trustworthy.

At the same time, you will have the opportunity to deepen your technical knowledge, gain experience in high-security environments, and develop further through targeted training and certifications.

What we offer

- Permanent employment in a stable, owner-managed German IT company
- Competitive salary and performance-based bonus
- Work on high-security IT and cybersecurity-related projects
- Individual training and development, including certification opportunities
- German courses, if needed
- Relocation support
- Meal allowance through our on-site cafeteria
- Sports and fitness benefits, including company football every two weeks
- A working environment based on trust, responsibility, and long-term cooperation

Important information

Due to the sensitive nature of our projects and the compliance requirements of our stakeholders, this position is fully on-site in the north of Munich. Remote work is not possible.

A security clearance is required. Candidates should either already have the necessary clearance or be willing to go through the process.

Hiring process

Initial remote interview > On-site interview in Munich > Offer > Security clearance process

How to apply

Apply easily — no cover letter required.

Please send us: your CV (in English), earliest possible start date, salary expectations, relevant certificates, if available

No applications from staffing or recruitment companies accepted.

Contact: Doris Böhner | +49 (0)89 660393-0 | jobs@datawh.de (https://mailto:jobs@datawh.de)

jobs.occupation: Physical Security Specialist - Data Center Security Operations (m/d/f) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 
 
The Physical Security Specialist responsible for Data Center Security Operations will support managing and executing daily physical security operations at assigned data centers, ensuring alignment with established policies and procedures. They will support routine site inspections, audits, and physical security system checks to maintain operational readiness and security risk assessments of locations as required.

The Physical Security Specialist will coordinate the activities of contracted security personnel (guard force/maintenance vendors), including scheduling, compliance, and performance monitoring in cooperation with Area Data Center Security Operations Lead, Data Center Management, Data Center Services, Lines of Business and market units. They will support projects of the installation, maintenance, and status of electronic security systems, report technical issues to vendors or IT team as needed. They will assist in case of physical security incidents on-site, including reporting, escalation, and coordination with law enforcement or emergency responders.

The Physical Security Specialist will maintain the highest level of professionalism in all activities to represent the organization internally and externally, while serving as a trusted advisor and ambassador for SAP and affiliated companies.

Competencies and Skills:

- Manage detailed programs related to the efficiency of the financial, operational and overall compliance of the organization.
- Seek to highlight ways to improve the effectiveness of the organization and its processes.
- Possess a good working knowledge and understanding of their industry and identify and collect key market information/trends and apply to the organization/processes.
- Manage and execute day to day delivery of multiple projects up and down the organization.
- Manage relationships often with global, regional and local senior management plus outside service providers and business partners.
- Manage processes and interfaces across organizational boundaries inside and outside of Global Physical Security management that relate to area of responsibility.
- Seek to drive operational excellence and quality assurance by providing best practices, problem solving, and guidance within his / her area of responsibility.  
- There may be occasional travel and responsibilities with in the region, or when required to support operations out side of the prescribed region.Serve as liaison to executive management / provide reports / champion internal goals and manage KPI's. 

Experience, Education, and Certifications:

- Experience in physical security industry or equivalent (military, law enforcement, etc.) or corporate physical security  
- Direct experience in the majority of ”Job Description” and “Competencies and Skills” above.
- A degree in related field (desirable).Ability to pass background verification and Government Security Clearance
- Fluent German speaking with comprehensive English language written and spoken a must.

​

Bring out your best

Help build the next generation of AI-enabled applications on SAP BTP

SAP is looking for a Senior Developer (f/m/d) to join the BTP Product Management Regional Implementation Group (RIG), a hands-on team focused on bringing the latest SAP innovations into real customer environments.
In this role, you will work directly with customers across Europe to design and implement production-intent solutions using SAP Business Technology Platform  and emerging AI capabilities. These projects sit at the intersection of engineering, product innovation, and customer collaboration, helping early adopters turn new technologies into working applications.
You will contribute to building AI-enabled applications, intelligent automation solutions, and modern cloud services, while also helping shape SAP’s products through direct feedback from real-world implementations.
If you enjoy hands-on development, working closely with customers, and experimenting with emerging technologies such as AI agents and intelligent workflows, this role offers a unique opportunity to have both technical and product impact.
 
What you’ll build
 

- Work with customers across the EMEA/MEE region to design and implement production-intent solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform . These implementations will focus on AI-enabled applications, custom agents, and intelligent applications on SAP Build and SAP AI Core, and on workflow orchestration using tools such as n8n. Through hands-on development, you will help transform emerging SAP capabilities into real, working solutions for customer use cases.
- Collaborate closely with your product manager, development architect, and customer technical teams to design and implement solutions using the latest SAP capabilities. This includes translating business requirements into scalable architectures and supporting customers as they adopt new technologies.
- You will stay current on SAP’s latest product releases and platform capabilities, evaluating their suitability for customer use cases and helping assess architectural approaches, implementation strategies, and technical trade-offs.
- You will contribute structured product feedback from real customer engagements, partnering with SAP Product Management and Architecture teams to improve product capabilities and the developer experience.
- You will assist in creating sample implementations, reference architectures, configuration examples, and developer enablement materials that help internal teams and future customers adopt new SAP technologies more easily.
 
What you bring:
 
- University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 6+ years of software development experience, including exposure to AI, LLMs, or agentic application development.
- Strong hands-on development experience in Python, Node.js, or Java, along with familiarity with LLM ecosystems and agent frameworks such as MCP or A2A.
- Experience building backend services, APIs, workflows, or distributed applications using modern development frameworks. You understand or are eager to deepen your expertise in LLM orchestration, agent tooling, and emerging interaction protocols such as MCP/A2A.
- Experience collaborating directly with customer developers, architects, and technical leads, contributing to design discussions, troubleshooting issues, and delivering solutions in mixed customer and SAP engineering teams.
- Strong curiosity and adaptability, with a passion for learning new technologies and experimenting with emerging development patterns, particularly in the AI and automation space.
- Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.
- Most importantly, you are energized by turning ambitious ideas into working software and solving real-world problems through hands-on engineering.
 
Where you belong:
 
As part of the BTP Product Management Regional Implementation Group (RIG), you will help bring early-stage SAP innovations into real customer environments.
RIG is a hands-on team within SAP BTP Product Management focused on accelerating the adoption of the latest SAP technologies. We work directly with early adopter customers to design and implement AI-centric scenarios, transforming new product capabilities into real, production-ready solutions.
These engagements validate product innovations in the field, create repeatable reference implementations, and provide valuable product feedback early in the product lifecycle.

- Minimum of 5+ years’ experience in IT security & compliance environments.
- Proven track record in managing IT and Data Protection security systems within cloud environments.
- Established project management skills and ability successfully develop projects and their team members.
